title: Sauti owner alert
description: A notification TO the owner (Noor): a booking arrived, a visitor wrote, a call was missed, a proposal is waiting. It informs; it acts on nobody's behalf, so it carries no approval and is never an action envelope. Facts in text come from code (date, party size, platform), never from a model or a translation. Delivery state (SMS sent, call placed) is kept beside the alert, never inside it: the alert is immutable and its digest proves it. Revision 1.1.0 (new in r1.1).

event_id.description: The hub intake event (call, SMS, e-mail) this alert reports.

action_id.description: For proposal_waiting: the envelope Noor may approve. Naming it here grants nothing; approval still needs its own record.

text.description: Exactly what the owner's SMS says. Code-generated from facts.

clip_keys.description: Clips the alert call plays, in order; empty when there is no call.

digest.description: sha256 over 'sauti.owner_alert.v1' + 0x00 + RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this object without the digest member.
